text: Program Description The Training Objectives "Through a series of full-English textile courses construction, establishing three textile program teaching modules: basic module, develop and support module, gradually forming a core system of program courses which including fiber materials, spinning, weaving, knitting, finishing, functional testing and so on, providing international students with an integrated full-English teaching platform for Textile Engineering program. Accordingly, a large amount of high-quality engineering-applied talents with engineering ethics, creative thoughts, good knowledge of international rules, ability to participate in international trade and international competition will be cultivated for our country and countries along the “the Belt and Road”. By taking this program, international students can grasp the fundamentals of textile and textile-related fields, have the ability to apply and develop textile technology, with good professional ethics, teamwork spirit and communication ability, creative thoughts, engineering practical ability and the international sights. After graduation, the students should be able to work in the field of textile and related sections about designing, manufacturing, quality inspection, trade management and so forth. " Main Courses Textile Chemistry, Spinning Technology, Woven Technology, Fabric Structure and Design, Design of Woven Products, Design of Knitted Products, Imports and Exports of Textiles & Apparel, Functional Finish of Textiles, Technical Textiles, Textile CAD
